shelfBands: const shelfBands = a=>{let out=[],sign=null;for(let x of a){let s=Math.sign(x);if(s!==sign){out.push(x);sign=s}else out[out.length-1]+=x}return out};
crateFields: const crateFields = s=>{let out=[],v='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(c==='"'){if(q&&s[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i++}else q=!q}else if(c===';'&&!q){out.push(v);v=''}else v+=c}return q?null:[...out,v]};
paintWindows: const paintWindows = a=>{let pts=[...new Set(a.flatMap(x=>x.slice(0,2)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),out=[];for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){let x=pts[i-1],y=pts[i],hit;for(let r of a)if(r[0]<=x&&r[1]>=y)hit=r;if(hit){let p=out.at(-1);if(p&&p[1]===x&&p[2]===hit[2])p[1]=y;else out.push([x,y,hit[2]])}}return out};
routePieces: const routePieces = s=>{let a=[];for(let p of s.split('/')){if(!p||p==='.')continue;if(p==='..'){if(a.length&&!a.at(-1).startsWith('!'))a.pop()}else a.push(p)}return '/'+a.join('/')};
ribbonExpand: const ribbonExpand = s=>{let i=0;function seq(nested){let o='';while(i<s.length&&s[i]!==']'){let c=s[i];if(/[a-z]/.test(c)){o+=c;i++}else if(/[0-9]/.test(c)){let n='';while(i<s.length&&/[0-9]/.test(s[i]))n+=s[i++];if(s[i++]!=='[')throw 0;let v=seq(true);o+=v.repeat(+n)}else throw 0}if(nested&&s[i++]!==']')throw 0;return o}try{let o=seq(false);return i===s.length?o:null}catch{return null}};
counterUndo: const counterUndo = a=>{let n=0,st=[];return a.map(c=>{if(/^\+-?\d+$/.test(c))n+=Number(c.slice(1));else if(c==='save')st.push(n);else if(c==='undo'&&st.length)n=st.pop();return n})};
labelLedger: const labelLedger = a=>{let m=new Map();for(let [k,v] of a){m.delete(k);if(v!==null)m.set(k,v)}return [...m]};
dashTokens: const dashTokens = s=>{let a=[''];for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){if(s[i]==='-'){if(s[i+1]==='-'){a[a.length-1]+='-';i++}else a.push('')}else a[a.length-1]+=s[i]}return a};
quietSpans: const quietSpans = (a,h)=>{let st=0,out=[];for(let n of a){if(n<0||n>=h)continue;if(n>st)out.push([st,n]);st=n+1}if(st<h)out.push([st,h]);return out};
foldParcel: const foldParcel = s=>{let st=[''];for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(c==='\\'){if(++i===s.length)return null;st[st.length-1]+=s[i]}else if(c==='(')st.push('');else if(c===')'){if(st.length===1)return null;let r=[...st.pop()].reverse().join('');st[st.length-1]+=r}else st[st.length-1]+=c}return st.length===1?st[0]:null};
patchRows: const patchRows = (a,b)=>{let m=new Map(a.map(r=>[r.id,{...r}]));for(let p of b){if(p.remove===true)m.delete(p.id);else {let {remove,...v}=p;m.set(p.id,{...m.get(p.id),...v})}}return [...m.values()]};
alternatingBins: const alternatingBins = a=>{let out=[],cur=[],sign=0;for(let n of a){let s=Math.sign(n);if(s&&s===sign){out.push(cur);cur=[]}cur.push(n);if(s)sign=s}if(cur.length)out.push(cur);return out};
checksumTiles: const checksumTiles = s=>{let n=0;return [...s].map(c=>{if(/[0-9]/.test(c)){n=(n+Number(c))%10;return String(n)}n=0;return c}).join('')};
mirrorKeys: const mirrorKeys = o=>{let m=new Map();for(let k of Object.keys(o))for(let v of o[k]){if(!m.has(v))m.set(v,[]);if(!m.get(v).includes(k))m.get(v).push(k)}return [...m]};
clockGaps: const clockGaps = a=>{let n=[...new Set(a.map(t=>+t.slice(0,2)*60+ +t.slice(3)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);if(!n.length)return null;return Math.max(...n.map((v,i)=>i?v-n[i-1]:v+1440-n.at(-1)))};
noteLinks: const noteLinks = (es,start)=>{let m=new Map(),out=[],seen=new Set();for(let [a,b]of es){if(!m.has(a))m.set(a,new Set());m.get(a).add(b)}while(!seen.has(start)){seen.add(start);out.push(start);let next=m.get(start);if(!next||next.size!==1)break;start=[...next][0]}return out};
escapedPairs: const escapedPairs = s=>{if(!s)return [];let out=[],key='',val='',eq=false;for(let i=0;i<=s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(i===s.length||c===','){if(!eq)return null;out.push([key,val]);key=val='';eq=false}else if(c==='\\'){if(++i===s.length)return null;if(eq)val+=s[i];else key+=s[i]}else if(c==='='&&!eq)eq=true;else if(eq)val+=c;else key+=c}return out};
peakShelves: const peakShelves = a=>{let out=[];for(let i=0;i<a.length;){let j=i+1;while(j<a.length&&a[j]===a[i])j++;if((!i||a[i]>a[i-1])&&(j===a.length||a[i]>a[j]))out.push([i,j,a[i]]);i=j}return out};
cappedWalk: const cappedWalk = (n,lo,hi,ds)=>{let spill=0;for(let d of ds){let raw=n+d;n=Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,raw));spill+=raw-n}return {final:n,spill}};
nestDepths: const nestDepths = s=>{let q=false,d=0,m=0;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(q&&c==='\\'){if(++i===s.length)return null}else if(c==="'")q=!q;else if(!q){if(c==='[')m=Math.max(m,++d);if(c===']'&&--d<0)return null}}return q||d?null:m};
windowVotes: const windowVotes = (a,w)=>{let out=[];for(let i=0;i+w<=a.length;i++){let m=new Map();for(let j=i;j<i+w;j++)m.set(a[j],(m.get(a[j])||0)+1);let best='',max=-1;for(let j=i;j<i+w;j++)if(m.get(a[j])>=max){best=a[j];max=m.get(best)}out.push(best)}return out};
rangeBadges: const rangeBadges = a=>{let out=[];for(let i=0;i<a.length;){let j=i+1;while(j<a.length&&a[j]===a[j-1]+1)j++;if(j-i>=3)out.push(a[i]+'..'+a[j-1]);else for(let k=i;k<j;k++)out.push(String(a[k]));i=j}return out.join(',')};
orderCrates: const orderCrates = (a,es)=>{let done=new Set(),out=[],known=new Set(a);while(out.length<a.length){let x=a.find(x=>!done.has(x)&&!es.some(([b,c])=>c===x&&known.has(b)&&!done.has(b)));if(x===undefined)return null;done.add(x);out.push(x)}return out};
softWrap: const softWrap = (a,w)=>{let out=[],cur=null;for(let v of a){if(cur===null)cur=v;else if(cur.length+1+v.length<=w)cur+=' '+v;else {out.push(cur);cur=v}}if(cur!==null)out.push(cur);return out};
palletNames: const palletNames = a=>{let used=new Set();return a.map(x=>{let y=x,k=1;while(used.has(y))y=x+'~'+k++;used.add(y);return y})};
holeFill: const holeFill = a=>a.map((x,i)=>{if(x!==null)return x;for(let d=1;d<a.length;d++){if(i-d>=0&&a[i-d]!==null)return a[i-d];if(i+d<a.length&&a[i+d]!==null)return a[i+d]}return null});
bracketTotals: const bracketTotals = s=>{let i=0;function space(){while(s[i]===' ')i++}function seq(depth,end){space();if(i===s.length||s[i]===']')return 0;let sum=0;while(true){space();let v;if(s[i]==='['){i++;v=seq(depth+1,true);space();if(s[i++]!==']')throw 0}else {let m=/^[+-]?\d+/.exec(s.slice(i));if(!m)throw 0;i+=m[0].length;v=+m[0]}sum+=v;space();if(s[i]!==',')break;i++;space();if(i===s.length||s[i]===']')throw 0}return sum*depth}try{let v=seq(1,false);space();return i===s.length?v:null}catch{return null}};
cancelMarks: const cancelMarks = s=>{let a=[];for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){if(s[i]==='\\'){if(i+1<s.length)a.push(s[++i]);else a.push('\\')}else if(s[i]==='#')a.pop();else a.push(s[i])}return a.join('')};
